title: Crestline Battery Line Card: Shelf Prices, Ratings and Fitment (Battery Replacement Warranties)
content:
Every battery Crestline sells carries one of six Battery Replacement Warranties, named for the line. This line card sets out, for each line, the construction it is built on, the vehicles it is fitted to, its shelf price, its rated performance and how many active battery warranties of that line one vehicle may carry.

## Line schedule

| Line | Construction | Fitment | Shelf price (USD) | Rated cold cranking amps | Rated reserve capacity (minutes) | May be fitted to a start-stop vehicle | Active battery warranties one vehicle may carry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | flooded | BCI group listed for the vehicle | 139.99 | 540 | 90 | No | 1 |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | flooded | BCI group listed for the vehicle | 169.99 | 640 | 100 | No | 1 |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | enhanced flooded | BCI group listed for the vehicle | 199.99 | 730 | 110 | No | 1 |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | AGM | BCI group listed for the vehicle; required for start-stop vehicles | 239.99 | 760 | 120 | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | AGM | BCI group listed for the vehicle; required for start-stop vehicles | 279.99 | 850 | 140 | Yes | 1 |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | heavy-duty flooded | light truck, commercial van and medium-duty groups; commercial usage | 189.99 | 950 | 160 | No | 2 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The shelf price is the price of the line in its most common group sizes; the rated cold cranking amps and the rated reserve capacity are likewise those of the line's most common group size.
2. The last column counts active battery warranties on one vehicle. Only the Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery allows two, for dual-battery trucks; every other line allows one.
3. The start-stop column states whether the line may be fitted to a start-stop vehicle. The two AGM lines are the only lines marked Yes, and their fitment entry lists them as required for start-stop vehicles.

## Reading the card

- **Which lines are AGM?** The Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery and the Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery.
- **Which line is built for commercial usage?** The Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery, fitted in light truck, commercial van and medium-duty groups.
- **Do the Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery and the Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery differ only in price?** No. They differ in construction (enhanced flooded against AGM), in shelf price (199.99 against 239.99), in rated cold cranking amps (730 against 760), in rated reserve capacity (110 against 120 minutes) and in start-stop fitment (No against Yes).
